items.note: WHO regrets the United States’ notification of withdrawal from WHO – a decision that makes both the United States and the world less safe. items.title: Timor-Leste certified malaria-free by WHO
items.note: The World Health Organization (WHO) has certified Timor-Leste as malaria-free, a remarkable achievement for a country that prioritized the disease and embarked on a concerted, nation-wide response shortly after gaining independence in 2002. “WHO congratulates the people and government of Timor-Leste on this significant milestone,” said Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, WHO Director-General.
